doc: Per hole: edits[] = {action add|replace|remove, kind, target, polygon_ll [[lon,lat]], polygon_frame_x_along [[x yds right of the line, yds along from the Back tee]], evidence, confidence, expected_effect}. Frame = Back tee -> aim of course_data/truth/gateway_national/render/frames.json (par 3: Back tee -> green centre). Paint order: native first, then rough islands, fairway, water, sand, green, trees last (as trace.py: EXTRA before auto()). hazards[] = bunker / water reach and carry distances (yds from the Back and Middle tee markers of package.json).
sources: USGS 3DEP lidar IL_10CoNRCS_3_D23 (flown 2023-12 / 2024-01, ~27 pts/m2; covers UTM northing >= 4282838 only: all of 17, most of 18, 16 from ~130 yds, 15 tee to ~250)
USGS 3DEP lidar IL_HicksDome_FluorsparDist_3_2019 work unit (flown 2020-12-02, ~8 pts/m2; the rest)
